ability.name: Burden Draw

startPose.stance: kneeling or braced beside the injured person
startPose.weightDistribution: weight committed through the contact arm
handPositions: one wrapped hand makes direct contact
free hand braces near Orin's sternum
startPose.silhouette: one grounded contact line connecting healer and patient

handPositions: one wrapped palm directly contacts the injury
free hand braces near Orin's sternum
bodyMotion: recoil collapses inward rather than outward
activation.facialExpression: focused restraint that breaks into a brief involuntary wince

windup.description: Orin settles the wrapped contact hand over the existing injury and locks his shoulders.

body.rightArm: contact arm straightens only enough to establish full palm contact

activation.description: The wound's vivid color compresses toward the point under Orin's palm.

release.description: The injury vanishes from the patient as the same burden traces beneath Orin's wrapped arm.

body.rightArm: arm tenses but does not fling outward

impact.description: Orin's body takes the cost: his breath catches and a contained unnatural pulse moves under the wrapping.

recovery.description: He removes contact slowly and hides the affected hand close to his body.

visualSignature.silhouette: A single grounded contact line between Orin and the injured person; the effect collapses inward toward him.
visualSignature.energyShape: compressed organic rings that narrow into the contact point rather than a projectile
visualSignature.impactLanguage: The patient's wound closes as Orin physically absorbs a contained recoil.
visualSignature.aftermathLanguage: A brief unnatural trace moves beneath Orin's wrapping and fades.

vfx.energyShape: compressed organic rings narrowing into the contact point
vfx.distortion: subtle local refraction around the contact hand
vfx.travelBehavior: all visible energy travels from the existing injury toward Orin; never away as a projectile
vfx.impactBehavior: patient injury reduces at the same moment Orin takes a compact inward recoil
vfx.aftermathBehavior: subdermal pulse beneath Orin's wrapping, then rapid fade

preferredShots: two-shot showing both patient injury and Orin contact hand
preferredAngles: high three-quarter angle when hand geography must be explicit
cameraLanguage.heroMoment: Hold the instant the wound disappears from the patient and appears as a contained trace beneath Orin's wrapping.
avoid: angles that hide the contact hand
framing that makes the technique look like a projectile attack

mustNotDo: Erase the cost rather than transferring it.
